data.name: Maanya
data.gender_notes: Maanya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maanya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mana' meaning 'mind' or 'thought'. It signifies one's pride, desire, or ambition. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Mahalakshmi is often associated with the quality of maanya, representing the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Maanya carries the meaning “Desire, Ambition, Pride” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Maanya usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, ambition, pride and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner strength, determination, and self-worth.
data.etymology: Maanya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Ambition, Pride.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maanya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
